blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine men’s baseball team missed out on a spot in the Super Round of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after bowing to host Japan, 7-0, on Wednesday at Toyohashi Municipal Baseball Stadium. Starting pitcher Raymond Nerosa gave up five runs in his 2 2/3-inning appearance, including a two-run homer from Yukiya Yano in the second inning, while the Philippine bats were kept silent by only getting three hits to drop their final Group A match. Coach Orlando Binarao’s squad ended group play with a 1-2 record, good for only third place as Japan and China secured the spot in the […]...
